hypotheses.reasoning: A template-svc-reconciler transaction (80804) held a row lock on notifications for more than 108s (#191). After that, UPDATEs on notifications hit lock wait timeouts (#208, #219, #225), and template-svc queries were canceled by the 10s statement timeout (#209). That made notification-svc's render calls time out after 15s (#211), and the gateway returned 504s. The gateway disk warning and the notif-worker GC pause look unrelated.
The notif-worker GC pause shows some heap pressure, but notif-worker isn't on the failing request path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Kill the long-running reconciler transaction 80804 in notif-db. Change template-svc-reconciler to use short transactions or batching, and add a lock or transaction timeout so this can't happen again.
